name: narciphbrowser
description: NarciPHBrowser - an open-source fingerprint browser: Donut-style product surface, Camoufox engine.

scripts.app:release: pnpm --filter @narc/desktop build && cargo build --release -p narrc-desktop --features custom-protocol && cargo build --release -p narrc-sidecar && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');for(const d of [path.join('target','release','binaries'),path.join('apps','desktop','src-tauri','binaries')]){fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(path.join('target','release',process.platform==='win32'?'narrc-sidecar.exe':'narrc-sidecar'),path.join(d,process.platform==='win32'?'narrc-sidecar.exe':'narrc-sidecar'));console.log('sidecar copied to',d);}"
